data.question: Fed cuts rates by 25 bps in September 2026?
data.description: This market will resolve to Yes if the Federal Open Market Committee announces a decrease of exactly 25 basis points to the federal funds target range at its meeting concluding on September 17, 2026, as published in the official FOMC statement. If the meeting is postponed beyond September 30, 2026, this market will settle to No. Revisions issued after the initial statement do not change settlement. The official source for resolution is the Federal Reserve FOMC statement.
